text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Three years of challenges alongside Katsuragi Ace.
Those rebellious hoofprints have finally reached their end—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Yet, she continues moving 'forward.'
Even when there is no path, she carves one out and keeps on running."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: As long as there are those who burn with the will to fight against fate in this endlessly cruel world.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Katsuragi Ace raised the flag high and continued to shout.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"As the 'Ace' who defies destiny,
all the way to the end of the road that will one day come—"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text: —Well then, guess it's about time I get going!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah. Take care on the way.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Man, seriously, flying all the way to America...
she's got crazy initiative...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, winning that last graded race made me realize my potential.
So all that's left is to keep looking forward and go for it!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
“Still, it's all thanks to you, Es-cchi!
Thanks for fighting alongside me.”

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"The one who seized that future was yourself.
—Keep on doing your best from here on out."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Keep in touch every now and then!
If you ever come back to Japan,
let's hang out again!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Red Ribbon
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Alright, I'm off!
See you later! Good luck to both of you too!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Did you say you already found a place near the university?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Moving out is still pretty far off,
but I was thinking of sorting through my personal belongings
little by little starting now—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
...We're finally parting ways—
All of us, heading down different paths.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: ...In the end, I couldn't win a graded race, but I was really happy that I managed to place at the very end.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
You looked so cool.
Even after the race, you stood with such dignity.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
...You see, back then,
I was just copying everything Ace-chan did.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
Because I've been watching you run, Ace-chan.
Because knowing you were fighting alongside me
in this world gave me strength—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"I fought with dignity right to the end.
...I have no regrets.
So with this confidence, I will 'move forward' to the next...!"

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"...You know, once I graduate from college,
there's something I want to do."

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
...I want to run mobile racing workshops.
All over Japan, in all sorts of places.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
I want kids who have never run, who know nothing
about it, to experience the world of racing.
That... is my dream right now.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text: —The place where I want to fight next.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
"...Who knows, maybe an incredible Umamusume
who surpasses even Ace-chan
will emerge from that."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha—I like the sound of that!
I can't wait...!!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume with Black-Rimmed Glasses
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Ace-chan,
for giving me the courage to fight.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: —From the inside, it's Shiina Frejus!! Could this be the resurgence of Shiina Frejus?!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Shiina Frejus crosses the line!!!
Shiina Frejus takes the win!!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Hell yeah!!
We did it, Frejus...!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
What an incredible race that was...!
That final clash was so intense!
It felt like pure grit, or maybe an unyielding obsession—

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"...On the final stretch today,
I was remembering the way you ran."

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
"If it were Katsuragi Ace, she wouldn't give up here."
...That is the true nature of my final reserve of strength.

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text: I am truly grateful to you for fighting alongside me.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha. Modest as always, aren't you?
...So I'll just say 'you're welcome.'

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
...It is your turn next, Ace-san.
"That race" is coming up soon, is it not?

text_block_list.name: Shiina Frejus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone who has been inspired by you is surely waiting for you.
...Please do your best.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Yeah.
—Look forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Ah, no... it's just, you know.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Lately, everything around me has started
to move...
So many people are starting to 'step' 'forward'—"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
It just got me thinking.
Where will my "next" be?
Just how far can I really go?
choice_data_list: Where do you want to go, Ace?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I have no idea!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: I don't know, but...—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I just want to keep pushing forward until I drop.
Forward, and forward, no matter how far!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
And keep on screaming!
Let's fight!! Let's resist!!
'Cause I'll be right there fighting beside you!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"Your" "Ace,"
Katsuragi Ace, is right here!!
choice_data_list: —In that case, I'll stay with you until you drop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Until the very end of the road Katsuragi Ace travels,
I will fight alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As her Trainer.
As her one and only "Ace"!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Heheh!
Then to finish it off, let's collapse together—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Let's look up at this sky together!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—The sound of our high-five
echoed in the dawn like a sacred vow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—And Katsuragi Ace will take on the challenge.
Running in "that race" so many had longed for.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To advance to the "next step" that awaits beyond...
one that no one has ever known.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: —Times change.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Just as the world is cruel, time is equally merciless.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: All things are transient. Even the brilliant radiance that once burned deep in countless hearts is destined to fade away eventually—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Just as she is, just as you are, just as I am...—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: However... there are things that still won't fade.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
It was a memory.
Or perhaps a prayer. Or a wish.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: In other words――feelings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"The feelings born from our brilliance
are a power in and of itself—one that will never fade,
fighting against whatever cruelty comes our way."

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Ace, you see...
I believe today's race was... a miracle
born from those very feelings.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I am grateful... to have a place to stand in this blessed race.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Haha—
You're sounding even more pompous than usual, Rudolf!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: At times like that, a single word is enough.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Let's settle this!! ...Or something like that.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
Fufu—
Ah, that's true. ...How tactless of me.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: ...Then, lest I impose any further uncouthness, I shall quietly step aside and let you pass.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
—She is waiting.
Today, you are the first one who should face her.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, got it.
I'll be taking my leave then.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Oh, and one last thing—

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
"Let's race, Ace.
I'll be taking the victory."

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Look at you, you can totally do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOH!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...It's strange, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've been waiting for this all along.
To race like this with Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Me too, CB.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: "Still... That's only natural, right!"

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Because we're――――rivals!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"You and I are rivals.
Now, and forever."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Well then, shall we go?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Yeah, let's do this!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Someone wished for it.
—Everyone wished for it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I remember. That emotional thrill.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: That's why, once more—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A showdown between you and Mr. C.B. once more!!
